killedBy: roundtrip.mjs: the seams no vitest run can execute installs the AudioContext override before the seeding navigation
why: Leaves the two real `AudioContext`s the app builds at boot -- Howler's, when `createAudioEngine` first touches `Howler.volume()`, and `engine.ts`'s `ensureCtx`. On a host whose audio service never connects each constructor returns only after an internal 20-second timeout, so the page blocks for ~40 s before `load` fires and the leak sweep dies on Playwright's 30 s navigation default before it has counted a single context. `npm run visual` cannot then be run at all on such a machine, which is what the agent instructions ask for on any UI change.
